name: SDN Host P2P Discovery
description: Capability node for the host p2p_read discovery hostcalls (gateway loops G.2 + G.3 + G.4). Four methods, one hostcall each: 'peers_snapshot' forwards the routing-decision JSON as {"peer_id"?} to p2p.peers_snapshot (the host's peerstore/DHT/registry view: per-peer addrs, connectedness, agent version, published standards, and stored $EPM profiles as an aligned size-prefixed stream segment); 'standards_snapshot' forwards to p2p.standards_snapshot (newest signed $PNM per (peer, standard) with per-entry attribution); 'pnm_history' forwards {"peer_id","limit"} to p2p.pnm_history (the peer's stored signed $PNM publications, newest first; the HOST attributes by Ed25519 SIGNATURE against the peer's publication keys because the store's recorded peer id is only the gossip-delivering peer — entries carry signature_verified/attribution/publisher_key so provenance is never overstated; limit arrives pre-clamped by the route node). 'latest_dataset' forwards {"peer_id","standard","deliver":"ref" unless format=json} to p2p.latest_dataset (gateway loop G.4: the provider's newest published dataset batch when the host's OPT-IN gateway.pin covers the pair or the peer is the node itself AND the batch is fully materialized locally; otherwise known/pinned flags plus the newest signed-PNM pointer for the honest 404/503 — never a silent proxy fetch; stream delivery is a hostcall-bridge body reference except on the json path, where the bytes arrive as the inline segment). Each method re-emits the incoming decision frame verbatim on the 'decision' port (linear flow chaining) and pushes the RAW hostcall response envelope ([u32le metaLen][{"ok":..,"result":..} JSON][u32le segCount][[u32le segLen][bytes]]*) on the 'snapshot' port; segment 0 carries the $EPM/$PNM stream referenced as {"$bin":0} in the result. A decision with route=not_found short-circuits: no hostcall, an empty-result envelope is emitted.

externalInterfaces.description: Policy-mediated read-only host discovery snapshots (peerstore + DHT + EPM registry + stored PNMs).

acceptedTypeSets.description: Discovery routing-decision JSON frame (foundation/http-route discover contract); "peerId" narrows the snapshot to one peer.

inputPorts.description: One routing-decision JSON frame per request.

acceptedTypeSets.description: The incoming decision frame re-emitted verbatim (linear chaining; no host round-trip).

Verbatim p2p.peers_snapshot hostcall response envelope: meta JSON {"ok","result":{"self","peers":[{"peer_id","addrs","connected","self","agent_version","standards","epm_index"}],"records":{"$bin":0}}} + segment 0 = aligned size-prefixed $EPM stream (stored profiles only; epm_index -1 = none).

methods.description: Forwards {"peer_id"?} to the p2p.peers_snapshot hostcall and emits the raw response envelope plus the decision passthrough. BATCHING: every input port here is single-stream BY CONTRACT and that is now ENFORCED IN CODE, not merely declared. maxStreams/maxBatch/drainPolicy are purely DECLARATIVE in the compiled flow runtime - space_data_module_runtime_begin_node_invocation pops the node whole queue port-blind up to the drain budget (64) - so a node that read ordinal 0 of a port and returned used to destroy every other frame it was handed there, with nothing re-delivering them and nothing logging the loss (live P1 cellular-multiprovider-returns-only-first-provider). A surplus is now refused with error code "batched-input-frames", naming the port and the count. See graph task modules-guest-nodes-drop-batched-frames.

methods.description: Forwards {"peer_id","standard"(,"deliver":"ref")} to the p2p.latest_dataset hostcall and emits the raw response envelope plus the decision passthrough. The host serves the newest publication batch whose signed PNM verifies under the peer's publication keys AND whose shard content is fully materialized locally — gated by the OPT-IN gateway.pin config (a node's own publications are always servable). Unpinned/unmaterialized answers carry the newest PNM pointer instead of bytes.
